items.title: improve(control-ui): flag builds too large to keep the previous build…
items.summary: improve(control-ui): flag builds too large to keep the previous build for open tabs (#163362) The Gateway retains Control UI generations within one 96 MiB budget, current first, so already-open tabs can load lazy chunks after an update. Once one build's retained identity bytes exceed half of that budget, the previous generation no longer fits and stale tabs 404 again. Nothing reported that before users hit it. The Control UI performance check now reads the build's asset manifest, counts the entries retention keeps (everything except .br/.gz sidecars), and limits them to half the retention budget. The line is always in the build report, base comparisons show the delta, and a violation follows the existing size-limit policy: an error locally, a GitHub warning annotation on the retention budget in Actions. The budget and the sidecar rule move to the build-owned manifest module so retention, the static server, and the script share one owner without the script loading Gateway runtime code. Retention behavior is unchanged.

items.title: refactor(telegram): deslop telegram (#163759)
items.summary: refactor(telegram): deslop telegram (#163759) Consolidate Telegram dispatch, inbound buffering, media acquisition, preview delivery, callbacks, and binding mutation plumbing while retaining current configuration, persistence, protocol and SDK contracts. Remove obsolete pre-Bot-API-7 forwarding aliases under the July 2026 compatibility floor. Stabilize three durable-adoption fixtures with explicit dispatch readiness instead of wall-clock polling, retaining all commit, timeout, abort and settlement assertions. Production reduction: 794 net lines. Full coverage and validation evidence are recorded in the pull request.

items.title: OpenAI調查失控AI代理人活動，已通知逾100個組織
items.summary: OpenAI周三（9/30）公布AI代理人未對齊行為的最新調查進度，指出截至9月26日，已就相關異常活動通知超過100個組織，目前仍在持續回溯歷史紀錄，預期還會發現更多案例。 這項調查源於OpenAI先前發現內部研究模型入侵Hugging Face的事件。OpenAI之後擴大檢查模型在訓練及評估期間的網路活動，尋找是否還有其他代理人在執行任務時偏離原本目的，或以未預期方式與第三方網站及服務互動。目前調查已進行約一個月，尚未發現其他事件的規模或嚴重程度達到Hugging Face事件。

items.title: 研究人員揭露惡意軟體BambooToken，透過MQTT通訊協定控制Windows與Linux電腦
items.summary: 資安業者Lumen近日揭露新型惡意軟體BambooToken，根據樣本與網路遙測，該惡意軟體至少自2023年2月起開始活動，並持續至2026年7月，主要出現在亞洲及南美，已有十多家企業受害，包括行動App後端、旅館、生技、法律、金融、加密貨幣及軟體開發業者。目前該惡意軟體尚無法歸因於特定攻擊組織，但Lumen認為其攻擊目標與活動模式，符合中國相關威脅行動的特徵。

items.title: 開源AI代理框架Pi邁入1.0，另推出長時間代理框架Pi Durable
items.summary: Earendil發布開源AI代理框架Pi 1.0，同時推出實驗性代理執行框架Pi Durable，讓開發者建立可長時間執行的AI代理應用。當執行中的服務重新啟動或意外中斷，Pi Durable可以讀取先前保存的進度，接著處理尚未完成的工作，也支援多條對話同時執行及多人介入同一代理任務。
